integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single continuous coloured-pencil animation begins with the exact rear-facing green pear character, flower crown, body proportions, grounded feet, meadow, lighting and composition established by Picture 1. He gently shifts weight onto one short planted foot and pivots to his right with several small supporting steps. His round torso, head and attached white flower crown rotate together through a readable right-side profile, then gradually turn toward the camera. His small round hands stay attached to the sides of the pear-shaped body, and his two short green feet support the turning weight. As his front becomes visible, it reveals his cream oval face, broad brown zigzag closed eyes, pink cheeks and tiny triangular white tooth, together with the green body spots, large white flower petals, green leaves, blue petal accents and two yellow stamens. The pencil strokes and soft shading match the opening. He completes the turn by four seconds, then makes one small friendly hand wave and settles facing the camera for the final second. His full rounded silhouette, flower and two feet remain readable in the same fixed composition.
